description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 09.05.2022 to 15.05.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under legal/statutory instruments, and rescinds a previous notification - all characteristics of Legal/Regulatory gazettes. While it names the Director General of Customs, this is in an official capacity to establish the legal authority for the regulation, not as a personnel appointment or government restructuring matter.
